caption: Results of our model with different weights of negative samples.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the relationship between the weight of negative sampling and NPMI values for three different datasets: 20NG, IMDB, and NIPS. The x-axis, labeled "weight of negative sampling," has a linear scale ranging from 0.5 to 3.5, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.5. The y-axis, labeled "NPMI," has a linear scale ranging from 0.22 to 0.42, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.02. The plot features three lines: a black line with square markers and a solid line style representing 20NG, a red line with circular markers and a solid line style representing IMDB, and a blue line with triangular markers and a solid line style representing NIPS. The black line starts at approximately 0.37 and ends at approximately 0.38, exhibiting minor fluctuations. The red line starts at approximately 0.19 and ends at approximately 0.20, also exhibiting minor fluctuations. The blue line starts at approximately 0.40 and ends at approximately 0.41, then decreases to approximately 0.40.
